proposed_capability: Bounded, cross-chat deterministic context envelope and read-only retrieval routing over existing goal, mechanics, perception and authority owners; context never executes Sims effects.
player_save_control_impact: No auto-reading, saving, profile writes, background retrieval, desktop focus, queue mutation or tool execution. Stable opaque household and Sim identities; only explicitly supplied, provenance-bearing records. Fresh authority must be checked independently at every effect.

strategic_discrimination.parent_objective: Make BetterInstincts agents converge across chats through predictable context windows and cohesive repository-owned decision logic.
rejected: Increase the prompt/context window without restoring state: truncation merely moves the failure.
Replace domain owners with a new universal agent brain: conflicts with existing task, mechanics, source and control contracts.
Execute graph queries or actions automatically: retrieval cost and wrong links would amplify unreliable evidence.
strategic_discrimination.selected: Introduce an optional deterministic context projection using provenance-ranked, budget-bounded records, tool descriptions, typed handoff and layered fault diagnosis; never duplicate source-owned decisions.
strategic_discrimination.first_discriminating_test: Replay reordered and stale records, missing graph edge, skipped retrieval and player intervention; assert stable bounded output, distinct diagnosis and no effect permit.

expected_outcome: One portable, inspectable context packet with pinned goal, corrections, denied paths, next gate, source scope, selected fresh evidence and suggested read-only owner; deterministic cross-chat handoff and diagnostic layer separation.
negative_tests: Untrusted/stale/cross-scope claims cannot silently become decisions
Different input order cannot change packet
Too-small context fails closed without dropping mandatory scope
No tool routing result can authorize execution
Missing data, failed retrieval and skipped lookup produce different fault layers
rollback_path: Revert optional source-only context port and host attachment; current domain and game/runtime paths remain unchanged.
unresolved_unknowns: No agent runner/installed game available in the GitHub connector; local MoonWake stage walker and Sims native P08 require a separate host.
Cross-chat persistence requires explicit serialization/transport by the caller; no background state service is authorized.
